newsitem.title: USA: Tyco, Western agree to drop litigation.
newsitem.headline: Tyco, Western agree to drop litigation.

text.p: A month after a fierce battle for control of an electronic security company, Tyco International Ltd announced an agreement with Western Resources Inc to drop all litigation between the two companies.
Tyco said in a statement released on Friday that the agreement included its wholly-owned subsidiary ADT Investments Inc, as well as Western's Westar Capital Inc.
The maker of fire protection systems said it had also signed a registration rights agreement providing for the registration of about 12.4 million Tyco shares held by Westar.
In July, Tyco's friendly stock agreement to buy ADT Ltd thwarted Western's competing bid.
As a result, Western, a utility, came to hold a large Tyco position -- 18.4 million shares -- through its stake in ADT.
Later that month, Western announced plans to sell more than 13 million shares in Tyco.
